methodology.fixed_count_input: I_API + delta tokenized(USER) + delta tokenized(instructions) + delta tokenized(canonical output schema)
methodology.USER_only_control: I_API + T(USER_new)-T(USER_old); retains all old non-USER overhead
methodology.outputs: Each scenario preserves the SUM of original output tokens, including multi-chunk groups
methodology.relevance: Old decisions frozen; all eligible classification documents retained, no negative/review pruning
methodology.extraction: Old positive-document groups retained; first original context keeps its original relevance metadata; no new classification is predicted
methodology.fixed_empty_intersections: Cost-only hypothetical empty USER excerpts, not valid actual requests
methodology.retention: Recorded exact global quote offset plus quote, attribution and non-null date evidence within ONE retained original span; lexical availability, not model recall or factual validation
methodology.scale: Conditional transfer of this259-record source composition; no probability CI, no full-research/scoring price
methodology.payload_limits: Local tokenizer differences estimate provider prompt rendering. Current payload factory/schema version is recorded; unseen rendering overhead assumed unchanged.
